titulo: Back after two weeks? Ask one thing: what changed
caption:
Back after two weeks? Ask one thing: what changed

Two weeks away. Cella comes back and asks only one thing: what changed? A new lamp. Now she sees it.

For whoever asked the one question.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a kitchen. At the top, the words: 2 weeks away. For whoever came back and did not ask. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes walks in from the left toward a table with a potted plant. The words appear one line at a time: I am back. What changed (a speech bubble above her). A new lamp (a reply bubble from the right, and a yellow lamp pops onto the table with a warm glow). Now I see it (her eyes close in a smile). The closing line: for whoever asked the one question. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella asked what changed. Somebody told her about the lamp.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-ene-s1, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Semana sin largos ni medios (prueba 3a del acta).
